QuestInfo.0: The Maple Administrator has something to say to you.

0.0: Hello, #h0#! I see you made it to Lv. 30. Well, it just so happens I have a gift for newbies who started after 02/05/13. Are you interested?

no.0: Oh, you don't want a gift? Okay. Talk to me if you change your mind.

yes.0: Open your Inventory and double-click on your gift! It's full of wonderful items that I just know you'll love! And there's more to be had when you get to Lv. 50. Good luck!
